newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Nice 1997 EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nice 1997 EPS raised.

text.p: Salomon Brothers raised its 1997 earnings per share estimate for Nice Systems to $1.31 from $1.27 after the Israeli company announced the signing of a definitive agreement to acquire Canada's Dees Communications.
Analyst Victor Halpert said he was raising his 1997 revenue estimate to $68.7 million from $64.7 million and in 1998 to $100.6 million from $89.2 million.

"We are adjusting our 1998 EPS estimate from $1.74 to $1.71, a slight decrease to reflect a large increase in the number of shares outstanding, reaching 10.7 million shares outstanding. Overall net income is expected to rise from $13.7 million to $18.31 million," Halpert said in a report released on Thursday.
Nice will issue new shares in connection with the acquisition and a planned secondary offering.
Both companies provide systems for the call centre market and their products are complementary, Halpert said.
"The most important aspect of the acquisition is the ability for Nice to offer a wide portfolio of products for the fast-growing call centre market," the report said.
